entities.name: Ademi of the Silkchutes
entities.description: A heroic dark skinned human who partners with a parachute-making spider and can temporarily fly via a spider-thread parachute.

entities.name: Balefang the Unslayable
entities.description: A demon dragon and rival of Baneslayer Angels.

entities.name: Betty Wray
entities.description: A human mercenary on Thunder Junction celebrated as a hero, wearing Freestrider clothing.

entities.name: Chira
entities.description: A human rogue and treasure hunter.

entities.name: Clutter Cluster
entities.description: A heroic brood of spiders that cleans up household clutter.

entities.name: Darval, Whose Web Protects
entities.description: A heroic spider-human hybrid with a human torso and the lower body of a spider.

entities.name: Desecrex, Gift of Servitude
entities.description: A symbiote villain appearing as a dark skinned humanoid mass with a glowing red center.

entities.name: Druneth, Reviver of the Hive
entities.description: A villainous human scientist whose goal appears to be reviving a Sliver hive.

entities.name: Elda, Conjurer of Spectacle
entities.description: A human magician whose modern clothing and art deco conjuring door may imply she is from New Capenna.

entities.name: Egrix the Bile Bulwark
entities.description: A symbiote spider hero, a large spider fused with a spiky symbiote.

entities.name: Everforger
entities.description: A construct blacksmith.

entities.name: Glava, Five-Advents Mage
entities.description: A human mage of the Five Advents.

entities.name: Homer
entities.description: A crab druid.

entities.name: Kavaero
entities.description: A heroic human with the ability to copy the faces of the deceased, possibly related to the spider on their head.

entities.name: Maular, the Next Evolution
entities.description: A two-headed dinosaur mutant.

entities.name: Rhilex
entities.description: A symbiote soldier hero in golden armor, partially covered in a black symbiote.

entities.name: Sahir, Visitor in Darkness
entities.description: A human wizard.

entities.name: Sala
entities.description: A humanoid squid pirate, deck boss of a ship with the Keelhaulers who took part in the Ghirapur Grand Prix.

entities.name: Sarn of the Silken Throne
entities.description: A heroic human who partners with a cat-sized black spider and wears web-like white armor.

entities.name: Skv'x
entities.description: A symbiote spider hero, a black symbiote fused with a large spider.

entities.name: Tethex, Gift of Malice
entities.description: A symbiote villain, a black scaled symbiote with a large purple maw.

entities.name: Tolabow
entities.description: An otter that may be from Eldraine.

entities.name: Uugguu, the Omniplasm
entities.description: A character known as the Omniplasm.

entities.name: Ur-Spider
entities.description: An ur-entity presumably similar to the Ur-Dragon, whose scions are a heroic human and spider duo.

entities.name: Verilax the Havenskin
entities.description: A symbiote hero covered in white scales and spikes, observed protecting forest animals from a fire.

entities.name: Viggo
entities.description: A human knight-like hero who fuses with a symbiote and then destroys the town he previously protected.

entities.name: Wardens of Silverweb Summit
entities.description: A heroic human and spider duo who protect Silverweb Summit.

entities.name: Yera and Oski
aliases: Yera and Oski, Weaver and Guide
entities.description: A heroic pair of a human guide and a spider.

entities.name: Baneslayer Angels
entities.description: Angels who are rivals of Balefang.

events.summary: Viggo, once protecting a boy, fuses with a large black symbiote and destroys the town he used to defend.
events.quote: After joining with the symbiote he is seen destroying the town he previously was protecting.

relations.quote: Balefang is a demon dragon and rival of Baneslayer Angels
